question.:question/problem:
Let $S=UV.$ What is the value of ${s}_{11}$, if
$U=\begin{bmatrix}-2 & 3 & -1 \\ 3 & 0 & 4\end{bmatrix}$
$V=\begin{bmatrix}-1 & -2 & 3 \\ 1 & 3 & -2 \\ 10 & 2 & -5\end{bmatrix}?$
question.:question/worked-solution:
The full matrix product is

$$
S=\begin{bmatrix}-2 & 3 & -1 \\ 3 & 0 & 4\end{bmatrix}\begin{bmatrix}-1 & -2 & 3 \\ 1 & 3 & -2 \\ 10 & 2 & -5\end{bmatrix}
$$

Multiplying the $1$st row in $U$ by the $1$st column in $V$, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}{s}_{11} & =\begin{bmatrix}-2 & 3 & -1\end{bmatrix}\begin{bmatrix}-1 \\ 1 \\ 10\end{bmatrix} \\  & =(-2)\cdot (-1)+3\cdot 1+(-1)\cdot 10 \\  & =2+3-10 \\  & =-5.\end{aligned}
$$

question.:question/problem:
Let $D=AB.$ What is the value of ${d}_{13}$, if
$A=\begin{bmatrix}-1 & 2 & 4 \\ 3 & 4 & -1 \\ -1 & 1 & 0 \\ 0 & 4 & -7\end{bmatrix}$
$B=\begin{bmatrix}1 & 1 & -2 & -3 \\ 0 & 4 & -1 & 1 \\ 2 & 0 & 3 & -3\end{bmatrix}?$
question.:question/worked-solution:
The full matrix product is

$$
D=\begin{bmatrix}-1 & 2 & 4 \\ 3 & 4 & -1 \\ -1 & 1 & 0 \\ 0 & 4 & -7\end{bmatrix}\begin{bmatrix}1 & 1 & -2 & -3 \\ 0 & 4 & -1 & 1 \\ 2 & 0 & 3 & -3\end{bmatrix}
$$

Multiplying the $1$st row in $A$ by the $3$rd column in $B$, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}{d}_{13} & =\begin{bmatrix}-1 & 2 & 4\end{bmatrix}\begin{bmatrix}-2 \\ -1 \\ 3\end{bmatrix} \\  & =(-1)\cdot (-2)+2\cdot (-1)+4\cdot 3 \\  & =2-2+12 \\  & =12.\end{aligned}
$$

$$

$$

$$
R=\begin{bmatrix}1 & -2 \\ 3 & -4 \\ 4 & -6 \\ 1 & -8 \\ 3 & -9\end{bmatrix}\begin{bmatrix}0 & 1 & 2 & -1 & 10 \\ 2 & 0 & 5 & -2 & 7\end{bmatrix}

$$
